items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: Bill Russell is identified only as an interviewer in the transcript context.

ctx.x: I guess it's working all right. I mentioned that this is Bill Russell and Ralph Collins interviewing Mr. Robinson and we're over at this is 1811 Terpsichore. Do you mind giving your full name? My name is Joseph Ralph Robinson. Middle name is Ralph. Do you mind telling just when you were born and where it was? Yeah. What was the date of your birthday? September 12, 1884. 1884. So you're 77 you say now? Yes. Were you born right here in the city? No. I was born in the country.
New Road, Louisiana. Where is that? Up the river? About 122 miles from here. Which way is that?
